### 7 Reasons Not to Worry, Part 1
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/7-reasons-not-to-worry-part-1
Passage: Matthew 6:25-26
Points:
- Anxiety ultimately stems from having little faith in God's future grace.
- Since God designed and gave us life and bodies, He is fully able and willing to supply food and clothing.
- God will ultimately raise our bodies and sustain them for eternal fellowship.
- If God faithfully feeds birds, He will surely care for humans, who are far more valuable and capable of glorifying Him.

### Worry-Free Living, Part 2
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-october-13-2025.html
Passage: Matthew 6:33-34
Points:
- Living free from worry requires embracing two principles: priorities and simplicity.
- Making God's kingdom and righteousness each morning's top priority causes lesser anxieties to fade.
- Trusting God with life's necessities restores peace, even when circumstances look bleak.
- Living one day at a time preserves energy and keeps tomorrow's worries from polluting today.
